title: Focused screenshot selection
responsibility: Projects stored focused screenshots of one unit and exact revision without granting a full verification verdict.

inputs.name: focusedCaptures.detail
inputs.description: Stored revision whose validated focused captures are considered; only points of this exact commit are eligible.

inputs.name: focusedCaptures.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit identifier; another unit cannot supply a missing screenshot.

inputs.name: focusedScenario.sides
inputs.description: Selected commit and first-parent evidence, retaining the union of their focused states and viewport declarations.

inputs.name: focusedScenario.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose focused gallery is described independently of full-verification scenario coverage.

outputs.name: focusedCaptures
outputs.description: Newest stored screenshot for each state and viewport, bound to this unit, served build and exact revision; no full verification verdict is granted.

outputs.name: focusedScenario
outputs.description: Focused gallery declarations with its captured states and viewports; empty when neither side has a usable focused image.
